## IPromotedRunLauncher

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Strategies.Interfaces.IPromotedRunLauncher</code>. Kind: `interface`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Interfaces/IPromotedRunLauncher.cs:18](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Interfaces/IPromotedRunLauncher.cs#L18).

Activates a promoted paper/live run on an execution engine. Implemented by the live trading engine and invoked by the promotion workflow once the target run entry has been durably recorded, closing the loop between promotion governance and execution.

## LiveTradingEngine

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Strategies.Live.LiveTradingEngine</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Live/LiveTradingEngine.cs:24](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Live/LiveTradingEngine.cs#L24).

Runs promoted paper/live strategy runs against the live market data feed. This is the live counterpart of BacktestEngine: promotion approval (or the startup resume sweep) hands a recorded StrategyRunEntry to TryLaunchAsync, which resolves the concrete strategy from the catalog, subscribes the run&#x27;s universe on the feed, drives the strategy callbacks per event, and routes resulting orders through the governed IOrderManager (OMS pre-trade gates included). Fills stream back from an OMS delivery-or-accounted execution-report subscription into OnOrderFill, closing the trading loop without allowing one slow run to block every other run.

```csharp
public sealed class LiveTradingEngine : IPromotedRunLauncher, IAsyncDisposable
```

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Models/StrategyLifecycleFactMapping.cs:10](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Models/StrategyLifecycleFactMapping.cs#L10).

## FileReconciliationRunRepository

Qualified name: <code>Meridian.Strategies.Services.FileReconciliationRunRepository</code>. Kind: `class`.

Source: [src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/FileReconciliationRunRepository.cs:17](../../../../src/Meridian.Strategies/Services/FileReconciliationRunRepository.cs#L17).

File-backed IReconciliationRunRepository that persists reconciliation run details to a JSON snapshot using atomic writes, so completed runs and their history survive process restarts. Replaces InMemoryReconciliationRunRepository for production workstation hosting while preserving identical query semantics. Every operation reads the current snapshot from disk (no in-memory cache), so runs written by another process sharing the same data directory remain visible to reads.

```csharp
public sealed class FileReconciliationRunRepository : JsonFileSnapshotStore<FileReconciliationRunRepository.ReconciliationRunSnapshot>, IReconciliationRunRepository
```
